verses.original: Καὶ εἰσελθὼν διήρχετο τὴν Ἰεριχώ
verses.transliteration: Kai eiselthōn diērcheto tēn Ierichō
verses.literal: Then Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through
verses.literalPt: E, TENDO Jesus entrado em Jericó, ia passando.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ὀνόματι καλούμενος Ζακχαῖος καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν ἀρχιτελώνης καὶ αὐτὸς πλούσιος
verses.transliteration: Kai idou anēr onomati kaloumenos Zakchaios kai autos ēn architelōnēs kai autos plousios
verses.literal: And there was a man named . . . Zacchaeus - a chief tax collector who was very wealthy
verses.literalPt: E eis que havia ali um homem chamado Zaqueu; e era este um chefe dos publicanos, e era rico.

verses.original: καὶ ἐζήτει ἰδεῖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν τίς ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου ὅτι τῇ ἡλικίᾳ μικρὸς ἦν
verses.transliteration: kai ezētei idein ton Iēsoun tis estin kai ouk ēdynato apo tou ochlou hoti tē hēlikia mikros ēn
verses.literal: He was trying to see who Jesus was but could not see over the crowd because he was small in stature
verses.literalPt: E procurava ver quem era Jesus, e não podia, por causa da multidão, pois era de pequena estatura.

verses.original: καὶ προδραμὼν εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν ἀνέβη ἐπὶ συκομορέαν ἵνα ἴδῃ αὐτόν ὅτι ἐκείνης ἤμελλεν διέρχεσθαι
verses.transliteration: kai prodramōn eis to emprosthen anebē epi sykomorean hina idē auton hoti ekeinēs ēmellen dierchesthai
verses.literal: So he ran on ahead and climbed . . . a sycamore tree to see Him since Jesus was about to pass that way
verses.literalPt: E, correndo adiante, subiu a um sicômoro para o ver; porque havia de passar por ali.

verses.original: Καὶ ὡς ἦλθεν ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον ἀναβλέψας ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Ζακχαῖε σπεύσας κατάβηθι σήμερον γὰρ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου δεῖ με μεῖναι
verses.transliteration: Kai hōs ēlthen epi ton topon anablepsas ho Iēsous eipen pros auton Zakchaie speusas katabēthi sēmeron gar en tō oikō sou dei me meinai
verses.literal: When . . . Jesus came to that place He looked up and said . . . . . . Zacchaeus hurry down for I must stay at your house today
verses.literalPt: E quando Jesus chegou àquele lugar, olhando para cima, viu-o e disse-lhe: Zaqueu, desce depressa, porque hoje me convém pousar em tua casa.

verses.original: Καὶ σπεύσας κατέβη καὶ ὑπεδέξατο αὐτὸν χαίρων
verses.transliteration: Kai speusas katebē kai hypedexato auton chairōn
verses.literal: So Zacchaeus hurried down and welcomed Him joyfully
verses.literalPt: E, apressando-se, desceu, e recebeu-o alegremente.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδόντες πάντες διεγόγγυζον λέγοντες ὅτι Παρὰ ἁμαρτωλῷ ἀνδρὶ εἰσῆλθεν καταλῦσαι
verses.transliteration: kai idontes pantes diegongyzon legontes hoti Para hamartōlō andri eisēlthen katalysai
verses.literal: And all who saw this began to grumble saying He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man
verses.literalPt: E, vendo todos isto, murmuravam, dizendo que entrara para ser hóspede de um homem pecador.

verses.original: Σταθεὶς δὲ Ζακχαῖος εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν Κύριον Ἰδοὺ τὰ ἡμίσιά μου τῶν ὑπαρχόντων Κύριε τοῖς πτωχοῖς δίδωμι καὶ εἴ τινός τι ἐσυκοφάντησα ἀποδίδωμι τετραπλοῦν
verses.transliteration: Statheis de Zakchaios eipen pros ton Kyrion Idou ta hēmisia mou tōn hyparchontōn Kyrie tois ptōchois didōmi kai ei tinos ti esykophantēsa apodidōmi tetraploun
verses.literal: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord Look Lord half of my possessions I give to the poor and if I have cheated anyone I will repay it fourfold
verses.literalPt: E, levantando-se Zaqueu, disse ao Senhor: Senhor, eis que eu dou aos pobres metade dos meus bens; e, se nalguma coisa tenho defraudado alguém, o restituo quadruplicado.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Σήμερον σωτηρία τῷ οἴκῳ τούτῳ ἐγένετο καθότι καὶ αὐτὸς υἱὸς Ἀβραάμ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros auton ho Iēsous hoti Sēmeron sōtēria tō oikō toutō egeneto kathoti kai autos huios Abraam estin
verses.literal: Jesus said to him Today salvation has come to this house because this man too is a son of Abraham
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe Jesus: Hoje veio a salvação a esta casa, pois também este é filho de Abraão.

verses.original: ἦλθεν γὰρ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ζητῆσαι καὶ σῶσαι τὸ ἀπολωλός
verses.transliteration: ēlthen gar ho Huios tou anthrōpou zētēsai kai sōsai to apolōlos
verses.literal: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost
verses.literalPt: Porque o Filho do homem veio buscar e salvar o que se havia perdido.

verses.original: Ἀκουόντων δὲ αὐτῶν ταῦτα προσθεὶς εἶπεν παραβολὴν διὰ τὸ ἐγγὺς εἶναι Ἰερουσαλὴμ αὐτὸν καὶ δοκεῖν αὐτοὺς ὅτι παραχρῆμα μέλλει ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀναφαίνεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Akouontōn de autōn tauta prostheis eipen parabolēn dia to engys einai Ierousalēm auton kai dokein autous hoti parachrēma mellei hē basileia tou Theou anaphainesthai
verses.literal: While the people were listening to this Jesus proceeded to tell them a parable because He was near Jerusalem and they thought the kingdom of God would appear imminently
verses.literalPt: E, ouvindo eles estas coisas, ele prosseguiu, e contou uma parábola; porquanto estava perto de Jerusalém, e cuidavam que logo se havia de manifestar o reino de Deus.

verses.original: εἶπεν οὖν Ἄνθρωπός τις εὐγενὴς ἐπορεύθη εἰς χώραν μακρὰν λαβεῖν ἑαυτῷ βασιλείαν καὶ ὑποστρέψαι
verses.transliteration: eipen oun Anthrōpos tis eugenēs eporeuthē eis chōran makran labein heautō basileian kai hypostrepsai
verses.literal: So He said A man of noble birth went to a distant country to lay claim to his kingship and then return
verses.literalPt: Disse pois: Certo homem nobre partiu para uma terra remota, a fim de tomar para si um reino e voltar depois.

verses.original: καλέσας δὲ δέκα δούλους ἑαυτοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς δέκα μνᾶς καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Πραγματεύσασθε ἐν ᾧ ἔρχομαι
verses.transliteration: kalesas de deka doulous heautou edōken autois deka mnas kai eipen pros autous Pragmateusasthe en hō erchomai
verses.literal: Beforehand he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas Conduct business with this until I return he said
verses.literalPt: E, chamando dez servos seus, deu-lhes dez minas, e disse-lhes: Negociai até que eu venha.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ πολῖται αὐτοῦ ἐμίσουν αὐτόν καὶ ἀπέστειλαν πρεσβείαν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ λέγοντες Οὐ θέλομεν τοῦτον βασιλεῦσαι ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Hoi de politai autou emisoun auton kai apesteilan presbeian opisō autou legontes Ou thelomen touton basileusai eph’ hēmas
verses.literal: But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say We do not want this man to rule over us
verses.literalPt: Mas os seus concidadãos odiavam-no, e mandaram após ele embaixadores, dizendo: Não queremos que este reine sobre nós.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐπανελθεῖν αὐτὸν λαβόντα τὴν βασιλείαν καὶ εἶπεν φωνηθῆναι αὐτῷ τοὺς δούλους τούτους οἷς δεδώκει τὸ ἀργύριον ἵνα γνοῖ τίς τί διεπραγματεύσαντο
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en tō epanelthein auton labonta tēn basileian kai eipen phōnēthēnai autō tous doulous toutous hois dedōkei to argyrion hina gnoi tis ti diepragmateusanto
verses.literal: When . . . . . . he returned from procuring his kingship he summoned . . . . . . the servants to whom he had given the money to find out what each one had earned
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, voltando ele, depois de ter tomado o reino, disse que lhe chamassem aqueles servos, a quem tinha dado o dinheiro, para saber o que cada um tinha ganhado, negociando.

verses.original: Παρεγένετο δὲ ὁ πρῶτος λέγων Κύριε ἡ μνᾶ σου δέκα προσηργάσατο μνᾶς
verses.transliteration: Paregeneto de ho prōtos legōn Kyrie hē mna sou deka prosērgasato mnas
verses.literal: The first servant came forward and said Master your mina has produced ten more minas
verses.literalPt: E veio o primeiro, dizendo: Senhor, a tua mina rendeu dez minas.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Εὖγε ἀγαθὲ δοῦλε ὅτι ἐν ἐλαχίστῳ πιστὸς ἐγένου ἴσθι ἐξουσίαν ἔχων ἐπάνω δέκα πόλεων
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autō Euge agathe doule hoti en elachistō pistos egenou isthi exousian echōn epanō deka poleōn
verses.literal: His master replied . . . Well done good servant Because you have been faithful in a very small matter you shall have authority over ten cities
verses.literalPt: E ele lhe disse: Bem está, servo bom, porque no mínimo foste fiel, sobre dez cidades terás autoridade.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ δεύτερος λέγων Ἡ μνᾶ σου κύριε ἐποίησεν πέντε μνᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kai ēlthen ho deuteros legōn Hē mna sou kyrie epoiēsen pente mnas
verses.literal: The second servant came and said Master your mina has made five minas
verses.literalPt: E veio o segundo, dizendo: Senhor, a tua mina rendeu cinco minas.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ καὶ τούτῳ Καὶ σὺ ἐπάνω γίνου πέντε πόλεων
verses.transliteration: Eipen de kai toutō Kai sy epanō ginou pente poleōn
verses.literal: And . . . to this one he said You shall have authority over five cities
verses.literalPt: E a este disse também: Sê tu também sobre cinco cidades.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ ἕτερος ἦλθεν λέγων Κύριε ἰδοὺ ἡ μνᾶ σου ἣν εἶχον ἀποκειμένην ἐν σουδαρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho heteros ēlthen legōn Kyrie idou hē mna sou hēn eichon apokeimenēn en soudariō
verses.literal: Then another servant came and said Master here is your mina which I have laid away . . . in a piece of cloth
verses.literalPt: E veio outro, dizendo: Senhor, aqui está a tua mina, que guardei num lenço;

verses.original: ἐφοβούμην γάρ σε ὅτι ἄνθρωπος αὐστηρὸς εἶ αἴρεις ὃ οὐκ ἔθηκας καὶ θερίζεις ὃ οὐκ ἔσπειρας
verses.transliteration: ephoboumēn gar se hoti anthrōpos austēros ei aireis ho ouk ethēkas kai therizeis ho ouk espeiras
verses.literal: For I was afraid of you because you are a harsh man You withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow
verses.literalPt: Porque tive medo de ti, que és homem rigoroso, que tomas o que não puseste, e segas o que não semeaste.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Ἐκ τοῦ στόματός σου κρίνω σε πονηρὲ δοῦλε ᾔδεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπος αὐστηρός εἰμι αἴρων ὃ οὐκ ἔθηκα καὶ θερίζων ὃ οὐκ ἔσπειρα
verses.transliteration: Legei autō Ek tou stomatos sou krinō se ponēre doule ēdeis hoti egō anthrōpos austēros eimi airōn ho ouk ethēka kai therizōn ho ouk espeira
verses.literal: His master replied . . . You wicked servant I will judge you by your own words So you knew that I am a harsh man withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow
verses.literalPt: Porém, ele lhe disse: Mau servo, pela tua boca te julgarei. Sabias que eu sou homem rigoroso, que tomo o que não pus, e sego o que não semeei;

verses.original: καὶ διὰ τί οὐκ ἔδωκάς μου τὸ ἀργύριον ἐπὶ τράπεζαν κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν σὺν τόκῳ ἂν αὐτὸ ἔπραξα
verses.transliteration: kai dia ti ouk edōkas mou to argyrion epi trapezan kagō elthōn syn tokō an auto epraxa
verses.literal: Why . . . then did you not deposit my money in the bank and upon my return . . . I could have collected it with interest
verses.literalPt: Por que não puseste, pois, o meu dinheiro no banco, para que eu, vindo, o exigisse com os juros?

verses.original: Καὶ τοῖς παρεστῶσιν εἶπεν Ἄρατε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ τὴν μνᾶν καὶ δότε τῷ τὰς δέκα μνᾶς ἔχοντι
verses.transliteration: Kai tois parestōsin eipen Arate ap’ autou tēn mnan kai dote tō tas deka mnas echonti
verses.literal: Then he told those standing by Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas
verses.literalPt: E disse aos que estavam com ele: Tirai-lhe a mina, e dai-a ao que tem dez minas.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Κύριε ἔχει δέκα μνᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kai eipan autō Kyrie echei deka mnas
verses.literal: Master they said he already has ten
verses.literalPt: (E disseram-lhe eles: Senhor, ele tem dez minas.)

verses.original: Λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι παντὶ τῷ ἔχοντι δοθήσεται ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ μὴ ἔχοντος καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Legō hymin hoti panti tō echonti dothēsetai apo de tou mē echontos kai ho echei arthēsetai
verses.literal: He replied, ‘ I tell you that everyone who has will be given more but the one who does not have even what he has will be taken away from him
verses.literalPt: Pois eu vos digo que a qualquer que tiver ser-lhe-á dado, mas ao que não tiver, até o que tem lhe será tirado.

verses.original: πλὴν τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου τούτους τοὺς μὴ θελήσαντάς με βασιλεῦσαι ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ἀγάγετε ὧδε καὶ κατασφάξατε αὐτοὺς ἔμπροσθέν μου
verses.transliteration: plēn tous echthrous mou toutous tous mē thelēsantas me basileusai ep’ autous agagete hōde kai katasphaxate autous emprosthen mou
verses.literal: And these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them bring them here and slay them in front of me
verses.literalPt: E quanto àqueles meus inimigos que não quiseram que eu reinasse sobre eles, trazei-os aqui, e matai-os diante de mim.

verses.original: Καὶ εἰπὼν ταῦτα ἐπορεύετο ἔμπροσθεν ἀναβαίνων εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: Kai eipōn tauta eporeueto emprosthen anabainōn eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: After Jesus had said this He went on ahead going up to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E, dito isto, ia caminhando adiante, subindo para Jerusalém.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤγγισεν εἰς Βηθφαγὴ καὶ Βηθανίαν πρὸς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν ἀπέστειλεν δύο τῶν μαθητῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto hōs ēngisen eis Bēthphagē kai Bēthanian pros to oros to kaloumenon Elaiōn apesteilen dyo tōn mathētōn
verses.literal: As He approached . . . Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives He sent out two of His disciples
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, chegando perto de Betfagé, e de Betânia, ao monte chamado das Oliveiras, mandou dois dos seus discípulos,

verses.original: λέγων Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν κατέναντι κώμην ἐν ᾗ εἰσπορευόμενοι εὑρήσετε πῶλον δεδεμένον ἐφ’ ὃν οὐδεὶς πώποτε ἀνθρώπων ἐκάθισεν καὶ λύσαντες αὐτὸν ἀγάγετε
verses.transliteration: legōn Hypagete eis tēn katenanti kōmēn en hē eisporeuomenoi heurēsete pōlon dedemenon eph’ hon oudeis pōpote anthrōpōn ekathisen kai lysantes auton agagete
verses.literal: saying Go into the village ahead of you and as you enter it you will find a colt tied there on which no one . . . has ever sat Untie it and bring it here
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Ide à aldeia que está defronte, e aí, ao entrar, achareis preso um jumentinho em que nenhum homem ainda montou; soltai-o e trazei-o.

verses.original: καὶ ἐάν τις ὑμᾶς ἐρωτᾷ Διὰ τί λύετε οὕτως ἐρεῖτε Ὅτι Ὁ Κύριος αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχει
verses.transliteration: kai ean tis hymas erōta Dia ti lyete houtōs ereite Hoti HO Kyrios autou chreian echei
verses.literal: If anyone asks Why . . . are you untying it tell him The Lord needs it
verses.literalPt: E, se alguém vos perguntar: Por que o soltais? assim lhe direis: Porque o Senhor o há de mister.

verses.original: Ἀπελθόντες δὲ οἱ ἀπεσταλμένοι εὗρον καθὼς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Apelthontes de hoi apestalmenoi heuron kathōs eipen autois
verses.literal: So those who were sent went out and found it just as Jesus had told them
verses.literalPt: E, indo os que haviam sido mandados, acharam como lhes dissera.

verses.original: λυόντων δὲ αὐτῶν τὸν πῶλον εἶπαν οἱ κύριοι αὐτοῦ πρὸς αὐτούς Τί λύετε τὸν πῶλον
verses.transliteration: lyontōn de autōn ton pōlon eipan hoi kyrioi autou pros autous Ti lyete ton pōlon
verses.literal: As they were untying the colt its owners asked - Why are you untying the colt
verses.literalPt: E, quando soltaram o jumentinho, seus donos lhes disseram: Por que soltais o jumentinho?

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν ὅτι Ὁ Κύριος αὐτοῦ χρείαν ἔχει
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan hoti Ho Kyrios autou chreian echei
verses.literal: The Lord needs it - they answered
verses.literalPt: E eles responderam: O Senhor o há de mister.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐπιρίψαντες αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐπὶ τὸν πῶλον ἐπεβίβασαν τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: Kai ēgagon auton pros ton Iēsoun kai epiripsantes autōn ta himatia epi ton pōlon epebibasan ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: Then they led the colt to Jesus threw their cloaks over it and put Jesus on it . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E trouxeram-no a Jesus; e, lançando sobre o jumentinho as suas vestes, puseram Jesus em cima.

verses.original: Πορευομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ ὑπεστρώννυον τὰ ἱμάτια ἑαυτῶν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ
verses.transliteration: Poreuomenou de autou hypestrōnnyon ta himatia heautōn en tē hodō
verses.literal: As He rode along the people spread their cloaks on the road
verses.literalPt: E, indo ele, estendiam no caminho as suas vestes.

verses.original: ἐγγίζοντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἤδη πρὸς τῇ καταβάσει τοῦ ὄρους τῶν Ἐλαιῶν ἤρξαντο ἅπαν τὸ πλῆθος τῶν μαθητῶν χαίροντες αἰνεῖν τὸν Θεὸν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ περὶ πασῶν ὧν εἶδον δυνάμεων
verses.transliteration: engizontos de autou ēdē pros tē katabasei tou orous tōn Elaiōn ērxanto hapan to plēthos tōn mathētōn chairontes ainein ton Theon phōnē megalē peri pasōn hōn eidon dynameōn
verses.literal: And as He approached . . . the descent from the Mount of Olives the whole multitude of disciples began to praise God joyfully in a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen
verses.literalPt: E, quando já chegava perto da descida do Monte das Oliveiras, toda a multidão dos discípulos, regozijando-se, começou a dar louvores a Deus em alta voz, por todas as maravilhas que tinham visto,

verses.original: λέγοντες Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ὁ Βασιλεὺς ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου Ἐν οὐρανῷ εἰρήνη καὶ δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις
verses.transliteration: legontes Eulogēmenos ho erchomenos ho Basileus en onomati Kyriou En ouranō eirēnē kai doxa en hypsistois
verses.literal: Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord Peace in heaven and glory in the highest
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Bendito o Rei que vem em nome do Senhor; paz no céu, e glória nas alturas.

verses.original: Καί τινες τῶν Φαρισαίων ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν Διδάσκαλε ἐπιτίμησον τοῖς μαθηταῖς σου
verses.transliteration: Kai tines tōn Pharisaiōn apo tou ochlou eipan pros auton Didaskale epitimēson tois mathētais sou
verses.literal: But some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Him Teacher rebuke Your disciples
verses.literalPt: E disseram-lhe de entre a multidão alguns dos fariseus: Mestre, repreende os teus discípulos.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν οὗτοι σιωπήσουσιν οἱ λίθοι κράξουσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis eipen Legō hymin hoti ean houtoi siōpēsousin hoi lithoi kraxousin
verses.literal: I tell you He answered . . . if they remain silent the very stones will cry out
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Digo-vos que, se estes se calarem, as próprias pedras clamarão.

verses.original: Καὶ ὡς ἤγγισεν ἰδὼν τὴν πόλιν ἔκλαυσεν ἐπ’ αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Kai hōs ēngisen idōn tēn polin eklausen ep’ autēn
verses.literal: As Jesus approached Jerusalem and saw the city He wept over it
verses.literalPt: E, quando ia chegando, vendo a cidade, chorou sobre ela,

verses.original: λέγων ὅτι Εἰ ἔγνως ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ καὶ σὺ τὰ πρὸς εἰρήνην νῦν δὲ ἐκρύβη ἀπὸ ὀφθαλμῶν σου
verses.transliteration: legōn hoti Ei egnōs en tē hēmera tautē kai sy ta pros eirēnēn nyn de ekrybē apo ophthalmōn sou
verses.literal: and said If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace But now it is hidden from your eyes
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Ah! se tu conhecesses também, ao menos neste teu dia, o que à tua paz pertence! Mas agora isto está encoberto aos teus olhos.

verses.original: ὅτι ἥξουσιν ἡμέραι ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ παρεμβαλοῦσιν οἱ ἐχθροί σου χάρακά σοι καὶ περικυκλώσουσίν σε καὶ συνέξουσίν σε πάντοθεν
verses.transliteration: hoti hēxousin hēmerai epi se kai parembalousin hoi echthroi sou charaka soi kai perikyklōsousin se kai synexousin se pantothen
verses.literal: For the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in . . . on every side
verses.literalPt: Porque dias virão sobre ti, em que os teus inimigos te cercarão de trincheiras, e te sitiarão, e te estreitarão de todos os lados;

verses.original: καὶ ἐδαφιοῦσίν σε καὶ τὰ τέκνα σου ἐν σοί καὶ οὐκ ἀφήσουσιν λίθον ἐπὶ λίθον ἐν σοί ἀνθ’ ὧν οὐκ ἔγνως τὸν καιρὸν τῆς ἐπισκοπῆς σου
verses.transliteration: kai edaphiousin se kai ta tekna sou en soi kai ouk aphēsousin lithon epi lithon en soi anth’ hōn ouk egnōs ton kairon tēs episkopēs sou
verses.literal: They will level you to the ground you and the children within your walls They will not leave one stone on another - because . . . you did not recognize the time of your visitation from God
verses.literalPt: E te derrubarão, a ti e aos teus filhos que dentro de ti estiverem, e não deixarão em ti pedra sobre pedra, pois que não conheceste o tempo da tua visitação.

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἤρξατο ἐκβάλλειν τοὺς πωλοῦντας
verses.transliteration: Kai eiselthōn eis to hieron ērxato ekballein tous pōlountas
verses.literal: Then Jesus entered . . . the temple courts and began to drive out those who were selling there
verses.literalPt: E, entrando no templo, começou a expulsar todos os que nele vendiam e compravam,

verses.original: λέγων αὐτοῖς Γέγραπται Καὶ ἔσται ὁ οἶκός μου οἶκος προσευχῆς ὑμεῖς δὲ αὐτὸν ἐποιήσατε Σπήλαιον λῃστῶν
verses.transliteration: legōn autois Gegraptai Kai estai ho oikos mou oikos proseuchēs hymeis de auton epoiēsate Spēlaion lēstōn
verses.literal: He declared to them It is written My house will be a house of prayer But you have made it a den of robbers
verses.literalPt: Dizendo-lhes: Está escrito: A minha casa é casa de oração; mas vós fizestes dela covil de salteadores.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν διδάσκων τὸ καθ’ ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν ἀπολέσαι καὶ οἱ πρῶτοι τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai ēn didaskōn to kath’ hēmeran en tō hierō hoi de archiereis kai hoi grammateis ezētoun auton apolesai kai hoi prōtoi tou laou
verses.literal: Jesus was teaching at the temple every day but the chief priests - scribes and leaders of the people were intent on killing Him
verses.literalPt: E todos os dias ensinava no templo; mas os principais dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, e os principais do povo procuravam matá-lo.

verses.original: καὶ οὐχ εὕρισκον τὸ τί ποιήσωσιν ὁ λαὸς γὰρ ἅπας ἐξεκρέματο αὐτοῦ ἀκούων
verses.transliteration: kai ouch heuriskon to ti poiēsōsin ho laos gar hapas exekremato autou akouōn
verses.literal: Yet they could not find a way to do so because all the people hung on His words
verses.literalPt: E não achavam meio de o fazer, porque todo o povo pendia para ele, escutando-o.
